transformations.operation: normalize source identifiers, URLs, effective dates, MIME types, and publisher labels
bind each retained source receipt to its recorded SHA-256, byte count, and retrieval status
retain explicit public statements about commissioning, specialist routing, committee decision date, and implementation context
exclude displacement, baseline costs, confidential prices, payer/HTA/policy/regulatory claims, and calibration parameters
do not impute missing n, m, d, mu, phi, annual effects, prices, or uncertainty distributions

authority: Atlas owner adjudication required before any transformation can be promoted
